name: Cloud Spire
description: Skyscraper that served as Obscura stronghold.

timeline.summary: Raffine summons Kamiz to the Cloud Spire and tells her someone attacked the visionaries; Kamiz must find who sent the vision.
timeline.quote: "Someone attacked the visionaries of New Capenna. Unacceptable."

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Kamiz tells Raffine the visions were not seen by Raffine herself, since the Cloud Spire has no halos.
timeline.quote: "Because you didn't see any vision at all."

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.
